definitions.correct: persisted state matches the independently recomputed procedure outcome (rejections must be attempted and surfaced, not merely absent)
definitions.intervention: case needing human input to reach the correct outcome
definitions.avgMs: mean HTTP round-trip ms per case (macro: per replayed step)
definitions.modelCalls: model API calls made by the agent (all procedural: 0)

limitations: Single run, 9 held-out cases; no statistical claims.
Baselines are documented procedural stubs, not LLM agents.
Verifier is a separate implementation of the same written procedure, not a second spec author.
